description: A university health center's institutional review board (IRB) has approved a mental health epidemiology study and requires an online version of the validated PHQ-9 (Patient Health Questionnaire-9) screening instrument. Log in to LimeSurvey at http://localhost/index.php/admin using admin/Admin123!. Build a complete survey titled 'PHQ-9 Mental Health Screening Study 2024'. The survey must have three question groups: 'Symptom Frequency' containing the nine PHQ-9 items as a single Array question with the standard four-point response scale (Not at all / Several days / More than half the days / Nearly every day), 'Functional Impact' containing a short-text question about how much the problems have interfered with daily functioning, and 'Demographics' containing radio-button questions for participant age range (Under 18 / 18-24 / 25-34 / 35-44 / 45-54 / 55-64 / 65 and older) and sex (Male / Female / Prefer not to say / Prefer to self-describe). The PHQ-9 Array question must be set as mandatory. The survey must be configured to anonymize all responses (IRB requirement for participant confidentiality). When construction is complete, activate the survey so it is ready to collect data.
